session_2026_08_04_validation_run.goal: run + test perfect 3D reconstruction and .c3d/.bvh/.obj Blender visualization
session_2026_08_04_validation_run.key_finding_marker_layouts: Sapiens2 Goliath-308's first 70 markers ARE MHR70, verified name-by-name; all 9 ALIGNMENT_MARKER_SPEC entries (incl. p68/p69 acromions, p70 neck) match exactly. So a Sapiens-308 DLT reconstruction can drive DINOv3 mesh alignment with the default indices.

bugs_found_and_fixed_this_session.symptom: Subject appeared MIRRORED in Blender: anatomical left/right swapped in both the BVH skeleton and the OBJ mesh.
bugs_found_and_fixed_this_session.cause: swap_yz wrote (x, z, y), a REFLECTION (det -1). Blender's BVH and OBJ importers then apply their own Y-up->Z-up ROTATION (det +1); net det -1.
bugs_found_and_fixed_this_session.fix: Write (x, z, -y) instead -- a proper rotation (-90 deg about X, det +1). Face winding reversal in apply_blender_yz_swap removed, since a rotation already preserves outward normals.
bugs_found_and_fixed_this_session.evidence: Marker labelled left_shoulder is anatomically left in 100% of 379 fast frames in the CSV, but was 0% after export; now 95.1% measured inside the Blender scene (misses are low-speed change-of-direction frames where velocity is a poor proxy for facing). BVH joints now reproduce the CSV in Blender world space to 0.00 mm (was 9005.67 mm).

bugs_found_and_fixed_this_session.symptom: 36 of 631 OBJ frames missing, so a Blender OBJ-sequence import drifted progressively out of sync with the C3D/BVH.
bugs_found_and_fixed_this_session.cause: reconstruct_mesh_sequence() dropped any frame where ANY of the 9 alignment markers was NaN -- but best_camera_alignment() already excludes non-finite rows per camera. On this fixture only the two acromions ever go missing, leaving 7 good correspondences.
bugs_found_and_fixed_this_session.fix: Removed the all-or-nothing guard; added an interpolate_similarity_transform()/slerp_rotation() fallback (per camera only, since transforms are not interchangeable) for frames that are genuinely unsolvable, plus a sequence_contiguous report.
bugs_found_and_fixed_this_session.evidence: 631/631 frames written, 0 interpolated, 0 skipped. Largest mesh-centroid step fell from 0.695 m (83 m/s) to 0.103 m (12.3 m/s); frames stepping >0.15 m went from 11 to 0. n_fit_points: 595 frames used 9 markers, 35 used 8, 1 used 7.

bugs_found_and_fixed_this_session.symptom: 30588 occluded marker-samples (15.7%) written as 0.0 with a VALID residual, so C3D viewers drew them as real markers piled on the world origin.
bugs_found_and_fixed_this_session.fix: Track the NaN mask and set meta_points.residuals = -1 for those samples (the C3D invalid-sample convention). Verified ezc3d round-trips -1 and returns NaN coordinates on read.
bugs_found_and_fixed_this_session.evidence: 0 valid samples at the origin after the fix; mm/m magnitude ratio still exactly 1000.

bugs_found_and_fixed_this_session.symptom: BVH wrote 0.0 for occluded samples, teleporting joints to the world origin mid-motion.
bugs_found_and_fixed_this_session.cause: BVH has no invalid-sample convention, and the code substituted 0.0.
bugs_found_and_fixed_this_session.fix: Linearly interpolate interior gaps and hold the nearest valid sample at head/tail before writing (48225 samples filled on this fixture).
bugs_found_and_fixed_this_session.note: 43539 samples belong to 23 markers never reconstructed at all (finger keypoints) -- nothing to fill from, so they remain at the origin.

bugs_found_and_fixed_this_session.symptom: 15 of the 63 Goliath-308 skeleton connections referenced never-reconstructed finger markers, drawing bones from the hands to (0,0,0).
bugs_found_and_fixed_this_session.fix: New find_unreconstructed_markers(); generate_blender_companion_script() now drops connections touching them.

level4_evidence.biomechanical_plausibility: thigh 0.42+/-0.02 m, shank 0.41+/-0.02 m, shoulder width 0.35 m (low SD => stable triangulation); hip speed median 3.5 max 6.9 m/s; trunk inclination median 28 deg, 53.6 deg at frame 300 during a 4.5 m/s change of direction
level4_evidence.caveat: 15 of 631 frames sampled in Blender; model judgment (level 4), not a substitute for the user's own review (level 5)
